entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dewesh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been preferred for challenging the order dated 19.09.2022 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate-II, Ballia in Complaint Case No.914 of 2020 (Pinki Gupta vs. Shivji Gupta and Others), through which petitioners have been summoned under sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act as well as order dated 29.01.2025 passed by learned Session Judge, Ballia in Criminal Revision No.173 of 2022 (Shivji Gupta and Another vs. State of U.P. and Another), through which above order dated 19.09.2022 has been upheld.
Shivji Gupta And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88253866/

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners pressed all the grounds whatsoever has been taken through the instant petition, through which it has been apprised that there is hardly any attraction of sections in which the petitioners have been summoned and all these grounds have not been taken into consideration while passing the impugned orders dated 19.09.2022 and 29.01.2025.
4.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as made in the petition on the ground that summoning order has been passed after considering the material available on record.
5. Be that as it may, no useful purpose shall be served by way of giving time for exchange of counter and rejoinder affidavits and keeping the matter pending before this Court.
Since the matter is hereby directed to proceed by the concerned court/Magistrate, the provision for issuing notices to the private respondents is hereby dispensed with.

6. In view of the above facts and circumstances of the case, learned Judicial Magistrate-II,
Ballia/court concerned is hereby directed to proceed with Complaint Case No.914 of 2020 (Pinki Gupta vs. Shivji Gupta and Others) and decide the same as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of 12 months from the date of production of certified copy of this order by way of giving proper opportunity of hearing to all the concerns.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.914 of 2020 (Pinki Gupta vs. Shivji Gupta and Others)

sentences.text: 7. Both the parties are hereby directed to extend their full co-operation to learned concerned court for receiving directions as made above and at the same time, it is also requested to learned concerned court for not extending unnecessary adjournment to any of the parties.

8. However, it is made clear that till the disposal of abovementioned complaint case, no coercive action shall be initiated against the petitioners, but at the same time it is also made clear that the petitioners shall ensure their presence through counsel before learned concerned court as and when it requires.
9. The instant petition stands disposed of accordingly.
